description:
Long-Range 48V 18Ah (864Wh) Battery
Ride farther with a high-capacity 18Ah battery, providing 70–140 km of real-world range depending on riding mode. The built-in battery lock adds anti-theft protection, ensuring peace of mind when parking your folding ebike in public areas.
Powerful 48V Motor for Confident Performance
Equipped with a high-torque 48V motor delivering 80Nm, this ebike ensures smooth acceleration, stable power output, and effortless climbing up to 25°. Combined with a 25 km/h riding speed and a reliable Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, it offers an efficient and enjoyable ride across city streets and varied terrain.
Smart APP & NFC Unlock for Enhanced Security
The BK6S PRO features intelligent APP integration with NFC unlocking for a more secure and convenient riding experience. Check mileage, battery status, and ride records directly on the app, or control lights and PAS levels remotely. Additional password and NFC security settings strengthen theft protection for daily commuting.
20×4.0 Puncture-Resistant Fat Tyres
Conquer any terrain with durable 20×4.0" fat tyres, offering superb grip and stability whether you’re cruising urban roads, gravel paths, or light off-road trails. Their puncture-resistant construction enhances safety and reliability, making this a versatile fat tyre ebike for all-weather conditions.
Full Comfort & Safety Package with TUV Certification
A lockable front suspension fork, hydraulic disc brakes, and a step-through frame ensure comfort and control on every journey. Bright front and rear lights, a practical rear rack, and full TüV certification complete a design built for daily commuting, leisure rides, and everything in between.
